verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א צֹ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ׀ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֗ישׁ כִּֽי־ שֻׁדַּ֤ד מִבַּ֙יִת֙ מִבּ֔וֹא מֵאֶ֥רֶץ כִּתִּ֖ים נִגְלָה־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: maś·śā ṣōr hê·lî·lū ’o·nî·yō·wṯ tar·šîš kî- šud·daḏ mib·ba·yiṯ mib·bō·w mê·’e·reṣ kit·tîm niḡ·lāh- lā·mōw
verses.literal: This is the burden against Tyre Wail O ships of Tarshish for Tyre is laid waste without house or harbor Word has reached them from the land of Cyprus
verses.literalPt: PESO de Tiro. Uivai, navios de Társis, porque está assolada, a ponto de não haver nela casa nenhuma, e de ninguém mais entrar nela; desde a terra de Quitim lhes foi isto revelado.

verses.original: דֹּ֖מּוּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אִ֑י סֹחֵ֥ר צִיד֛וֹן עֹבֵ֥ר יָ֖ם מִלְאֽוּךְ׃
verses.transliteration: dōm·mū yō·šə·ḇê ’î sō·ḥêr ṣî·ḏō·wn ‘ō·ḇêr yām mil·’ūḵ
verses.literal: Be silent O dwellers of the coastland you merchants of Sidon whose traders have crossed the sea
verses.literalPt: Calai-vos, moradores da ilha, vós a quem encheram os mercadores de Sidom, navegando pelo mar.

verses.original: וּבְמַ֤יִם רַבִּים֙ זֶ֣רַע שִׁחֹ֔ר קְצִ֥יר יְא֖וֹר תְּבֽוּאָתָ֑הּ וַתְּהִ֖י סְחַ֥ר גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ma·yim rab·bîm ze·ra‘ ši·ḥōr qə·ṣîr yə·’ō·wr tə·ḇū·’ā·ṯāh wat·tə·hî sə·ḥar gō·w·yim
verses.literal: On the great waters came the grain of Shihor the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre she was the merchant of the nations
verses.literalPt: E a sua provisão era a semente de Sior, que vinha com as muitas águas, a ceifa do Nilo, e ela era a feira das nações.

verses.original: בּ֣וֹשִׁי צִיד֔וֹן כִּֽי־ אָמַ֣ר יָ֔ם מָע֥וֹז הַיָּ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹֽא־ חַ֣לְתִּי וְלֹֽא־ יָלַ֗דְתִּי וְלֹ֥א גִדַּ֛לְתִּי בַּחוּרִ֖ים רוֹמַ֥מְתִּי בְתוּלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bō·wō·šî ṣî·ḏō·wn kî- ’ā·mar yām mā·‘ō·wz hay·yām lê·mōr lō- ḥal·tî wə·lō- yā·laḏ·tî wə·lō ḡid·dal·tî ba·ḥū·rîm rō·w·mam·tî ḇə·ṯū·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Be ashamed O Sidon the stronghold of the sea for the sea . . . has spoken I have not been in labor or given birth . . . I have not raised young men or brought up young women
verses.literalPt: Envergonha-te, ó Sidom, porque o mar, a fortaleza do mar, fala, dizendo: Eu não tive dores de parto, nem dei à luz, nem ainda criei jovens, nem eduquei virgens.

verses.original: כַּֽאֲשֶׁר־ שֵׁ֖מַע לְמִצְרָ֑יִם יָחִ֖ילוּ כְּשֵׁ֥מַע צֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer- šê·ma‘ lə·miṣ·rā·yim yā·ḥî·lū kə·šê·ma‘ ṣōr
verses.literal: When the report reaches Egypt they will writhe in agony over the news of Tyre
verses.literalPt: Como quando se ouviram as novas do Egito, assim haverá dores quando se ouvirem as de Tiro.

verses.literal: Cross over to Tarshish wail O inhabitants of the coastland
verses.literalPt: Passai a Társis; clamai, moradores da ilha.

verses.original: הֲזֹ֥את לָכֶ֖ם עַלִּיזָ֑ה מִֽימֵי־ קֶ֤דֶם קַדְמָתָהּ֙ יֹבִל֣וּהָ רַגְלֶ֔יהָ מֵֽרָח֖וֹק לָגֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: hă·zōṯ lā·ḵem ‘al·lî·zāh mî·mê- qe·ḏem qaḏ·mā·ṯāh yō·ḇi·lū·hā raḡ·le·hā mê·rā·ḥō·wq lā·ḡūr
verses.literal: Is this your jubilant city whose origin is from antiquity . . . whose feet have taken her to settle far away
verses.literalPt: É esta, porventura, a vossa cidade exultante, cuja origem é dos dias antigos, cujos pés a levaram para longe a peregrinar?

verses.original: מִ֚י יָעַ֣ץ זֹ֔את עַל־ צֹ֖ר הַמַּֽעֲטִירָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר סֹחֲרֶ֙יה֙ שָׂרִ֔ים כִּנְעָנֶ֖יהָ נִכְבַּדֵּי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: mî yā·‘aṣ zōṯ ‘al- ṣōr ham·ma·‘ă·ṭî·rāh ’ă·šer sō·ḥă·reh śā·rîm kin·‘ā·ne·hā niḵ·bad·dê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Who planned this against Tyre the bestower of crowns whose traders are princes whose merchants are renowned on the earth
verses.literalPt: Quem formou este desígnio contra Tiro, distribuidora de coroas, cujos mercadores são príncipes e cujos negociantes são os mais nobres da terra?

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת יְעָצָ֑הּ לְחַלֵּל֙ גְּא֣וֹן כָּל־ צְבִ֔י לְהָקֵ֖ל כָּל־ נִכְבַּדֵּי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ yə·‘ā·ṣāh lə·ḥal·lêl gə·’ō·wn kāl- ṣə·ḇî lə·hā·qêl kāl- niḵ·bad·dê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts planned it to defile all its glorious beauty to disgrace all the renowned of the earth
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR dos Exércitos formou este desígnio para denegrir a soberba de toda a glória, e envilecer os mais nobres da terra.

verses.original: עִבְרִ֥י אַרְצֵ֖ךְ כַּיְאֹ֑ר בַּת־ תַּרְשִׁ֕ישׁ אֵ֖ין מֵ֥זַח עֽוֹד׃
verses.literal: Cultivate your land like the Nile O Daughter of Tarshish there is no longer a harbor
verses.literalPt: Passa como o Nilo pela tua terra, ó filha de Társis; já não há quem te restrinja.

verses.original: יָדוֹ֙ נָטָ֣ה עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם הִרְגִּ֖יז מַמְלָכ֑וֹת יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה אֶל־ כְּנַ֔עַן לַשְׁמִ֖ד מָעֻזְנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏōw nā·ṭāh ‘al- hay·yām hir·gîz mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh ’el- kə·na·‘an laš·miḏ mā·‘uz·ne·hā
verses.literal: The LORD has stretched out His hand over the sea He has made kingdoms tremble He has given a command that the strongholds of Canaan be destroyed
verses.literalPt: Ele estendeu a sua mão sobre o mar, e turbou os reinos; o SENHOR deu ordens contra Canaã, para que se destruíssem as suas fortalezas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא־ תוֹסִ֥יפִי ע֖וֹד לַעְל֑וֹז הַֽמְעֻשָּׁקָ֞ה בְּתוּלַ֣ת בַּת־ צִיד֗וֹן כִּתִּיִּים ק֣וּמִי עֲבֹ֔רִי גַּם־ שָׁ֖ם לֹא־ יָנ֥וּחַֽ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō- ṯō·w·sî·p̄î ‘ō·wḏ la‘·lō·wz ham·‘uš·šā·qāh bə·ṯū·laṯ baṯ- ṣî·ḏō·wn kit·tī·yīm qū·mî ‘ă·ḇō·rî gam- šām lō- yā·nū·aḥ lāḵ
verses.literal: He said You shall rejoice no more . . . O oppressed Virgin Daughter of Sidon Get up and cross over to Cyprus even there you will find no rest
verses.literalPt: E disse: Nunca mais exultarás de alegria, ó oprimida virgem, filha de Sidom; levanta-te, passa a Quitim, e ainda ali não terás descanso.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן׀ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים זֶ֤ה הָעָם֙ לֹ֣א הָיָ֔ה אַשּׁ֖וּר יְסָדָ֣הּ לְצִיִּ֑ים הֵקִ֣ימוּ בְחִינָיו עֹרְרוּ֙ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ שָׂמָ֖הּ לְמַפֵּלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hên ’e·reṣ kaś·dîm zeh hā·‘ām lō hā·yāh ’aš·šūr yə·sā·ḏāh lə·ṣî·yîm hê·qî·mū ḇə·ḥī·nå̄w ‘ō·rə·rū ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā śā·māh lə·map·pê·lāh
verses.literal: Look at the land of the Chaldeans a people now of no account The Assyrians destined it for the desert creatures they set up their siege towers and stripped its palaces They brought it to ruin
verses.literalPt: Vede a terra dos caldeus, ainda este povo não era povo; a Assíria a fundou para os que moravam no deserto; levantaram as suas fortalezas, e edificaram os seus palácios; porém converteu-a em ruína.

verses.original: הֵילִ֖ילוּ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד מָעֻזְּכֶֽן׃ס
verses.literal: Wail O ships of Tarshish for your harbor has been destroyed
verses.literalPt: Uivai, navios de Társis, porque está destruída a vossa fortaleza.

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְנִשְׁכַּ֤חַת צֹר֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה כִּימֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶחָ֑ד מִקֵּ֞ץ שִׁבְעִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לְצֹ֔ר כְּשִׁירַ֖ת הַזּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·niš·ka·ḥaṯ ṣōr šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh kî·mê me·leḵ ’e·ḥāḏ miq·qêṣ šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh yih·yeh lə·ṣōr kə·šî·raṯ haz·zō·w·nāh
verses.literal: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years the span of a king’s life But at the end of seventy years it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the harlot
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia Tiro será posta em esquecimento por setenta anos, conforme os dias de um rei; porém no fim de setenta anos Tiro cantará como uma prostituta.

verses.original: קְחִ֥י כִנּ֛וֹר סֹ֥בִּי עִ֖יר זוֹנָ֣ה נִשְׁכָּחָ֑ה הֵיטִ֤יבִי נַגֵּן֙ הַרְבִּי־ שִׁ֔יר לְמַ֖עַן תִּזָּכֵֽרִי׃
verses.transliteration: qə·ḥî ḵin·nō·wr sōb·bî ‘îr zō·w·nāh niš·kā·ḥāh hê·ṭî·ḇî nag·gên har·bî- šîr lə·ma·‘an tiz·zā·ḵê·rî
verses.literal: Take up your harp stroll through the city O forgotten harlot Make sweet melody sing many a song . . . so you will be remembered
verses.literalPt: Toma a harpa, rodeia a cidade, ó prostituta entregue ao esquecimento; faça doces melodias, canta muitas canções, para que haja memória de ti.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה מִקֵּ֣ץ׀ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יִפְקֹ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ צֹ֔ר וְשָׁבָ֖ה לְאֶתְנַנָּ֑ה וְזָֽנְתָ֛ה אֶת־ כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh miq·qêṣ šiḇ·‘îm šā·nāh yip̄·qōḏ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ṣōr wə·šā·ḇāh lə·’eṯ·nan·nāh wə·zā·nə·ṯāh ’eṯ- kāl- mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: And at the end of seventy years the LORD will restore Tyre Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms on the face of the earth
verses.literalPt: Porque será no fim de setenta anos que o SENHOR visitará a Tiro, e ela tornará à sua ganância de prostituta, e prostituir-se-á com todos os reinos que há sobre a face da terra.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה סַחְרָ֜הּ וְאֶתְנַנָּ֗הּ קֹ֚דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א יֵֽאָצֵ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יֵֽחָסֵ֑ן כִּ֣י לַיֹּשְׁבִ֞ים לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה סַחְרָ֔הּ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל לְשָׂבְעָ֖ה וְלִמְכַסֶּ֥ה עָתִֽיק׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh saḥ·rāh wə·’eṯ·nan·nāh qō·ḏeš Yah·weh lō yê·’ā·ṣêr wə·lō yê·ḥā·sên kî lay·yō·šə·ḇîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh yih·yeh saḥ·rāh le·’ĕ·ḵōl lə·śā·ḇə·‘āh wə·lim·ḵas·seh ‘ā·ṯîq
verses.literal: Yet her profits and wages will be set apart to the LORD they will not be stored . . . or saved for her profit will go to those who live before the LORD for abundant food and fine clothing
verses.literalPt: E o seu comércio e a sua ganância de prostituta serão consagrados ao SENHOR; não se entesourará, nem se fechará; mas o seu comércio será para os que habitam perante o SENHOR, para que comam até se saciarem, e tenham vestimenta durável.
